description: This Java source file defines the EntityAutoEngine class, a service engine for handling entity operations like create, update, delete, and expire within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for executing these operations and ensuring security and entity consistency.

classes.name: EntityAutoEngine
classes.description: A final class extending GenericAsyncEngine that provides entity operation methods such as create, update, delete, and expire. It acts as a service engine within OFBiz, managing entity lifecycle actions securely.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Overrides the runSyncIgnore method to call runSync, ignoring certain exceptions for asynchronous processing.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Main method to handle create, update, delete, and expire operations for entities based on ModelService and parameters; includes validation, security checks, and dispatching appropriate internal methods.

methods.name: invokeCreate
methods.description: Creates a new entity, handling primary key logic, timestamps, and security considerations; returns success or error message.

methods.name: invokeUpdate
methods.description: Updates an existing entity after validating primary keys, permissions, and handling timestamp updates; returns success or error.

methods.name: invokeDelete
methods.description: Deletes an entity based on primary key lookup, ensuring proper permissions; returns success or error.

methods.name: invokeExpire
methods.description: Sets expiration dates on an entity, updating 'thruDate' or related date fields; typical for soft-deletion or deactivations.

methods.name: isValidText
methods.description: Validates input text parameters for security, specifically for file upload paths to prevent security issues.
